author: Hermes experimental / Nicholas
topic: ~/Documents is not the real Documents folder on localized/OneDrive-redirected Windows; FL user script scans silently miss
affected: any user-data path built from expanduser('~/Documents')

evidence.machine: Windows 11 Norwegian locale, OneDrive Known-Folder-Move: Personal shell folder = C:\Users\nicho\OneDrive\Dokumenter
evidence.symptom: daemon apply_notes wrote MCP_Apply.pyscript OK (readable back via same path), FL 21.2.2.3914 Piano roll Script menu never listed it across one restart; FL's REAL user settings tree (full subfolder layout incl. Hardware, Audio scripts) lives under OneDrive\Dokumenter and its 'Piano roll scripts' existed but was empty
evidence.false_trail: Documents\Image-Line\FL Studio existed but contains only 'Settings' because the DAEMON created it mid-session - an empty literal ~/Documents does NOT prove FL does not use it; compare against the shell-folder registry value instead
evidence.cure: registry HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\User Shell Folders /v Personal (expandvars) -> true docs root; resolver patch lands in pyscript_gen, verified RESOLVED: C:\Users\nicho\OneDrive\Dokumenter\Image-Line\FL Studio\Settings\Piano roll scripts

laws: never hardcode ~/Documents for user data on Windows; resolve Personal via User Shell Folders
recent-files registry values (General\FruityLoopsMainForm LastProjectPath etc.) reveal FL's real data roots on a mystery machine
a script menu that stays empty despite correct file + folder + extension = scan-path mismatch, not syntax
FL scans user piano-roll scripts at startup: file added mid-session needs an FL restart to appear
reproduction: write any valid .pyscript into literal %USERPROFILE%\Documents\Image-Line\FL Studio\Settings\Piano roll scripts on a KFM machine, restart FL, menu stays empty; copy same file into Personal-registry path, restart FL, menu lists it
open_questions: does 21.2.2 rescan when the Script submenu opens (avoiding the restart) - untested
exact menu placement for Script.Category 'MCP' header vs flat listing - pending first live run
next_action: restart daemon at next quiet moment to load resolver patch; until then apply_notes writes to the stale path - copy MCP_Apply.pyscript to the Personal path before triggering
